seed.author: @user1
seed.text: Here I am in November 2026, listening to this song on YouTube for the very first time, after all these years of not even knowing its title. I’m 30 years old, from Angola, and you can’t imagine how happy I felt when I finally discovered the name of this track! It takes me straight back to my teenage years in the 2000s. This song used to play on the radio back then, and it still does to this day. It’s one of those songs that instantly lifts your spirits, even when you don’t fully understand the lyrics. Listening to it now, as an adult, only makes me feel even more strongly that the world was a much better place back then. What a beautiful feeling to rediscover a piece of your childhood!
